description: This source file implements the API for managing a display device component within a TR-069 host interface, including retrieving status, EDID information, supported resolutions, and preferred resolution, as well as handling updates and placeholders for setting attributes.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceDisplayDevice
classes.description: Class managing display device attributes and interactions within the TR-069 host interface.

methods.name: hostIf_STBServiceDisplayDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing device ID and video port, setting backup states.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles setting display device attributes (currently not implemented).

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Retrieves display device attributes such as status, EDID, supported resolutions, etc.

methods.name: doUpdates
methods.description: Updates display device attributes to the host if they have changed.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets HDMI display connection status ('Present' or 'Absent').

methods.name: getX_COMCAST_COM_EDID
methods.description: Retrieves Comcast-specific EDID information if display is connected.

methods.name: getEDID_BYTES
methods.description: Retrieves EDID bytes from the display as a hex string.

methods.name: getSupportedResolutions
methods.description: Lists supported resolutions of the connected display.

methods.name: getPreferredResolution
methods.description: Gets the preferred resolution of the display.
